entry.name: stepcounter~
entry.digest: Count signal jumps in a sequence
entry.description: The stepcounter~ object uses signal jumps -- impulses and/or phasor resets -- to advance through a sequence of count values. The signal outputs of stepcounter~ can be used to generate a sequence of durations from a regular signal input pulse, such as is provided by the phasor~ object.
